about: Vectors for mpp/charge/xrpl. Fixtures are payer r3sN…6dTC, destination rpjf…EyN, and x402-exact-xrpl.json's V2 x402 blob, V3 MPP blob and the plant's memo blob. The placed request is computed with Python 3 json and base64url. Each reference names the payee of the challenge the payment answers, its request's recipient.

mpt.case: build, with build's fee, sequence and lastLedgerSequence, on the challenge placed from request: an MPT, its currency the JSON text {"mpt_issuance_id"} the stock parseCurrency reads (xrpl-mpp-sdk 0.1.0-beta.4 dist/chunk-JQG7ATQA.js:172-174). Its mpt_issuance_id is 48 hex digits as XLS-33 forms one: the issuance's Sequence, 7, as a big-endian UInt32, then the issuer's AccountID, that of rwzRswng9sqR9Buw2T8FG18K4n8xdd1dCa decoded by hand from base58 with the XRPL alphabet, its checksum checked. expectTxJson is written by hand from xrpl.org's Payment and Transaction Common Fields: Amount the MPT amount {mpt_issuance_id, value}, no SendMax, SourceTag the stock default 593184257 (dist/client/index.js:344), InvoiceID H's 64 hex digits in upper case.

issuedJson.case: build on an issued currency in the JSON text form {"currency", "issuer"} the stock parseCurrency reads (xrpl-mpp-sdk 0.1.0-beta.4 dist/chunk-JQG7ATQA.js:172-175), with methodDetails.memos as the stock schema has them (dist/chunk-L6LVAN2P.js:17-90). expectTxJson is the stock client's Payment for it: Amount and SendMax as for issued, SourceTag the stock default 593184257, and Memos as the stock encodeMemos writes them (dist/client/index.js:391-399), each given member's UTF-8 in upper-case hex, MemoType from type, MemoFormat from format, MemoData from data, in the request's order.

refused.case: pairingsOf and build refuse a request's currency that is not one of the string forms lcp reads whole: an object, which the stock schema does not take, a string (dist/chunk-L6LVAN2P.js:17-90), as lcp read one before; a CUR:issuer text with two colons and a JSON text with a member beside currency and issuer, which the stock parseCurrency (dist/chunk-JQG7ATQA.js:170-183) reads by their first two parts and by those two members, lcp's own stricter reading, so that no part of the currency goes unread; and methodDetails.memos in rippled's {Memo} form, whose members are not the schema's type, format and data. Each is expect.

refusals.case: build on a request whose methodDetails.memos is not the stock schema's array of objects of the optional strings type, format and data (xrpl-mpp-sdk 0.1.0-beta.4 dist/chunk-L6LVAN2P.js:17-90), here rippled's {Memo} form

bound, reference and build's complete with a Payment that carries NetworkID on testnet, whose id, 1, is at most 1024: rippled 3.4.1 (src/libxrpl/tx/Transactor.cpp L73-93, preflight0) refuses a transaction that carries NetworkID on a network whose id is at most 1024 (telNETWORK_ID_MAKES_TX_NON_CANONICAL, whatever its value), and on one above 1024 a transaction without it (telREQUIRES_NETWORK_ID) or with another id (telWRONG_NETWORK). Each blob is V3's Payment with NetworkID 1, then 1025, signed again by the payer, the key of Ed25519 entropy 01x16 by xrpl.org's Ed25519 Key Derivation (node:crypto's SHA-512Half): @noble/curves 2.4.0's signature over ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0's encodeForSigning, then ripple-binary-codec's encode; the same steps without NetworkID give back the blob byte for byte

buyer.about: The buyer gate's rows for this file's pairings, in the form of buyer.json's rows. B2 is the plant: the document advertises H, the hash of the ATR in B6's first check, and the link serves the planted ATR, that ATR with one byte changed; the gate declines hash-mismatch and never calls the signer. B6 is the pairing's bound check over the payment this file already holds: check(ATR, presented) gives H, and check(planted ATR, presented) declines signed-not-bound. Where the ATR is abc, H is its SHA-256 (FIPS 180-2 B.1) and the planted ATR is abd. SHA-256 values are GNU coreutils sha256sum, which openssl dgst -sha256 matches. Bytes are hex. A B2 input names the account, the buyer's inputs and the time (now, in seconds) its build needs. noSignedPayment names each pairing of the file that has no B6 row, and why.

rows.name: B6
rows.note: presented is this file's V3 payment, as the file holds it; no signature was made for this row.

multisigned.about: A multi-signed Payment is admitted: bound gives H and reference names the payer's instrument and the signed body, which is one for every quorum's copy of one payment, since the read finds a payment by its instrument and never by its hash. Each blob is the V3 Payment (1 000 000 drops, Sequence 7, LastLedgerSequence 1000) from payer r3sN…6dTC with SigningPubKey empty, Fee 48 and Signers from Ed25519 entropy 03x16, 04x16 and 05x16 (rPPdduC9MRTrXZP1J7MQyEKKEYiFigWZ6Q, rfPaNmieF15VqV752Q8qAc6ugtkKhWsA2R, rH9ESAdrFfDAZtCZGa7JiwNJfKnC6CmGFQ), multi-signed with xrpl-py 4.1.0 on Python 3.12.3 (transaction.sign with multisign=True, then transaction.multisign); each hash is xrpl-py's get_hash. The two-signer blob is the three-signer blob with the entry of the signer from 05x16 removed, byte for byte, and its hash differs: xrpl.org's Transaction Malleability page says a third party can remove a signature that the quorum does not need, and that any change gives a different hash.

boundChallenge.case: The file's credential at `credential`, a JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) into this file, presented with its echoed challenge replaced by `challenge`, the same challenge with the change the row's case names: pairingsOf, over the challenge as issued, does not name `pairing` for it, and that pairing's bound and reference refuse the credential with the row's code, the code pairingsOf gives (mpp/not-this-pairing where it names other pairings). The request is base64url, without padding, of its RFC 8785 form, except where the case says otherwise.

methodDetails.memos in rippled's {Memo} form, which the stock schema's memos (type, format, data) do not take

completeBlob.about: complete reads the signed blob it is given as bound reads the credential it makes, in bound's order: the credential's size (mpp-challenge.json credentialSize), then the blob as decodeBlob reads it: hex bytes, else xrpl/blob-malformed, of at most 32,768 hex digits (XRPL_MAX_BLOB_BYTES, 16,384 bytes), else xrpl/blob-too-large, that decode as a transaction, else xrpl/blob-malformed. A row's blob, unless the row is padded, is the row's blobBytes zero bytes in hex, and its credential is B6's payment with that blob and source, the payer's account as did:pkh:xrpl:{network}:{address}, which complete writes as the stock client does (xrpl-mpp-sdk 0.1.0-beta.4 dist/client/index.js:376-385). complete refuses such a blob with the row's code, and bound refuses the credential with it: zero bytes within both bounds do not decode as a transaction. At 32,367 bytes the credential, its source included, measures 65,535 and at 32,368 bytes 65,537, so the credential bound is read first there. A row with padded true is a blob that decodes: B6's transaction, decoded and re-encoded with ripple-binary-codec 2.11.0, its TxnSignature replaced by as many bytes of 0x11 as bring the blob to the row's blobBytes bytes. bound does not verify the signature, so at a row marked taken complete returns the credential, B6's payment with that blob, and bound gives H for it; at a row with expect, complete refuses with the row's code, and bound refuses the credential with it.

read.about: The read of mpp/charge/xrpl (the profile mpp-charge-xrpl.md, rules 6 to 9), each row on a constructed server holding ledgers 1 to ledger + 1, ledger validated, ledger 1000 where the row names none (test/fixtures/xrpl-reader.ts): reference of the row's credential under the placed challenge, read from ledger 900 at the mark validated for the act payment. tx answers V3's blob, validated at ledger 990 with tesSUCCESS and meta.delivered_amount 1000000 drops, only where the row's lookup finds it; account_tx answers landed for the payer's account alone, and account_info the payer's accountSequence at both ledgers, any other account being not found. Each expect is the answer the profile read-status (read-status.md) and the pairing's profile give that ledger.
